newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr stays weak vs yen on rising Japanese rates.
newsitem.headline: Dlr stays weak vs yen on rising Japanese rates.

text.p: *Dollar remains weak vs yen in morning Tokyo partly in reaction to rise in Japanese market interest rates.
*Yield of key 182nd 10-year JGB stood near 2.735 at 0117 GMT, up from previous day's close of 2.685 percent.
*But buying interest just below 115.30 yen supporting dollar for now.
*Focus on Japan's April industrial output data at 0430 GMT.
*Some exporters who had failed to sell dollars near 117 yen on Wednesday may be placing offers on upside, a dealer said.
*He said Japanese investors not active players so far. But dealers said they may be keen to buy greenback below 115 yen.
*A dealer at European bank said operators are selling dollars on topside after dollar failed to crawl clearly above 117 yen on Wednesday.
*Another dealer at different European bank said U.S. hedge funds strongly sold dollar for mark overnight, adding that dollar's topside will stay limited against mark and yen should this continue.
0012 GMT *Dollar eased slightly against yen in early Tokyo, but support expected near 115.30 and then 115.00 yen for now.
*Eyes on Japan's April industrial output data due at 0430 GMT and moves in Japanese market interest rates.
*"Strong figures in the industrial production data and a rise in Japanese interest rates could send the greenback below 115 yen," a city bank dealer said.
*Economists polled by Reuters forecast rises ranging from 0.3 percent to 1.5 percent in April output, compared with month-on-month drop of 0.3 percent in March.
